{{Top|leg}}
The '''X-wing squadron briefing amphitheater''' was located on [[Folor Base]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] training base on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Folor]]. It was where [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] usually briefed the new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Wraith Squadron]] during their training.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
